selection_status: Development template chosen after prior information preflight for informative radial coverage, not a held-out science target.
train_rule: All valid radius/speed/error rows outside the two six-row contiguous holdout annuli; no residual or outcome cuts.
shared_priors: Gaussian inclination 63+/-3deg; independent free positive global stellar and angular-gas amplitudes. Profiled model alone has Gaussian gamma0+/-0.1.
holdout_interpretation: Noiseless injected means; error-normalized residual power and linearized predictive-covariance power, not observed chi-square or actual detection significance.
exploratory_power_marker: Predictive residual power>=9 is only an optimistic 3-unit Gaussian separation marker; do not interpret as a calibrated rejection probability.
limits: Pointwise algebraic prescriptions, not AQUAL disk solutions
No correlated PSF or velocity/template covariance
Inclination changes velocity deprojection only, not the fixed light shape
No new Euclid or other external observations
